fields.finding: Both current lead models carry 100 kg systems. Identified sealed hardware is 30-50 kg. Zylon barrier and previously omitted joint adhesive may be funded from remaining allocation only by explicit reallocation; other installed hardware is unresolved.
fields.proposed_next: Keep the whole 100 kg reserved, book all new masses once, and do not assign unused allowance to payload before a complete bill exists.
